request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
The sage-green sofa works well with the **sand-coloured rug**, but the floor’s colour/material isn’t included in the supplied scene, so I can’t confirm that pairing.

The palette is earthy and balanced: muted sage, warm cream walls, sandy beige, brown wood tones, terracotta and brass. The sofa adds a gentle cool contrast to those warmer shades.

One optional improvement: a slightly lighter cream rug would give the sofa more definition while keeping the palette calm. Nothing has been changed.
